description: Search InterPro entries or member signatures by text or entry type. GO filters require sourceDatabase interpro; integratedInto selects member signatures for an InterPro accession. Results are cursor-paged; use interpro_get_entry for full metadata.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this tool with unchanged filters; limit may change.

goCategory.description: GO category: P biological process, F molecular function, C cellular component; requires sourceDatabase interpro and cannot combine with goTerm.

goTerm.description: GO annotation identifier such as GO:0003677; requires sourceDatabase interpro and cannot combine with goCategory.

integratedInto.description: Integrating InterPro accession; requires a member sourceDatabase.

limit.description: Positive integer page size; values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice; defaults to 20.

query.description: Text to search; omit all filters to browse the database.

sourceDatabase.description: Database to search; defaults to interpro.

name: interpro_search_entries

entries.description: Complete entry summaries from this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incompatible_go_filters`: Both goTerm and goCategory are supplied. `go_filters_require_interpro`: goTerm or goCategory is supplied for a member sourceDatabase. `database_mismatch`: Integration filtering is requested on the integrating database. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor decoding or scope fails, or upstream rejects continuation. `entry_withdrawn`: InterPro answers the search with HTTP 410, reporting a withdrawn record. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, structure, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Effective page size after clamping to the tool maximum.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation with unchanged target and filters.

title: Search InterPro entries
